title: Isoloom JSON events and errors
description: One line of an Isoloom lifecycle command's --json output (newline-delimited JSON): an event, or the error document that ends a failed command.

Event.description:
One thing a lifecycle command reports while it runs. Every event carries the time it was
emitted (`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`, UTC).

oneOf.description: A step of the command started (`running`), finished (`done`) or failed (`failed`).

target.description: The target the environment runs on (`docker`, `vagrant`...), when known.

machine.description: The machine the step is about; null for the whole environment.

step.description: The step: see the list in `docs/json.md` (`prepare`, `up`, `checks`...).

detail.description: A short human-readable detail (a folder, a count, a reason).

oneOf.description:
A line the underlying tool (docker compose, vagrant, terraform, kubectl, ssh) printed
during a step.

machine.description: The machine the tool works on, when it is one.

step.description: The step the tool runs for.

oneOf.description: One check's result (`isoloom test`).

position.description: Where the check ran from: a machine, or the environment's networks.

detail.description: Why it failed (empty when it passed).

oneOf.description: The command's outcome: the last event of a command that succeeded.

ok.description: Whether it reached its goal (false: checks failed, a machine's command failed).

data.description: What the command found or produced: see `docs/json.md` for each command.

oneOf.description: Started, not finished yet.
Finished and succeeded.
Finished and failed; an error document usually follows.

Stream.description: Which output of the underlying tool a log line came from.

oneOf.description: Its standard output.
Its standard error (where most tools print their progress).

ErrorDocument.description: The last line a failed command prints with `--json`: `{ "error": { ... } }`.

code.description: What kind of failure: stable, see [`ErrorCode`].

message.description: The message the command line prints after `error:`.

machine.description: The machine it is about, when it is one.

step.description: The step that failed, when one was running (see the `step` events).

hint.description: What to do about it, when there is something to say beyond the message.

ErrorCode.description:
The stable codes of errors: what kind of failure, for a program to react to without reading
the message.

oneOf.description:
The command line's arguments don't make sense together (an unknown action, a missing
command after `--`).
No spec in the folder, or it can't be read or parsed.
The spec parses but has problems (listed in `problems`).
The profile asked for can't be read or doesn't fit the spec.

A launch-time input the environment needs isn't set (in the shell or the profile's
`inputs`).
No target by that name.
The spec can't run on the target, or several targets are possible and none was named.
The target's files couldn't be generated.
This host lacks what the target needs (a tool, a credential): see `isoloom doctor`.
A tool the target runs with isn't installed.
The tool ran and failed (its output came as `log` events).
Nothing is running there: run the environment first.
No machine (or tool, or group) by that name in the environment.
No network by that name, or the machine isn't on it.
The command doesn't do that on this target yet.
Reading or writing a file failed.
Anything else.

FieldProblem.description: One problem of an invalid spec: the field's path and the reason.

message.description: What is wrong, and the fix when there is one.
